title.zh: 将莱特省Baybay市镇西莱特总医院床位由50张增至75张并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Western Leyte General Hospital in the Municipality of Baybay, Province of Leyte, From Fifty to Seventy-Five Beds, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Western Leyte General Hospital in the Municipality of Baybay, Province of Leyte, From Fifty to Seventy-Five Beds, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tăng sức chứa giường bệnh của Bệnh viện Đa khoa Western Leyte tại Đô thị Baybay, Tỉnh Leyte từ 50 lên 75 giường, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเพิ่มจำนวนเตียงของโรงพยาบาลทั่วไป Western Leyte ในเทศบาล Baybay จังหวัด Leyte จาก 50 เป็น 75 เตียง และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang meningkatkan kapasitas tempat tidur Rumah Sakit Umum Western Leyte di Kotamadya Baybay, Provinsi Leyte dari 50 menjadi 75 tempat tidur, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta meningkatkan kapasiti katil Hospital Besar Western Leyte di Perbandaran Baybay, Wilayah Leyte daripada 50 kepada 75 katil, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1972/ra_6624_1972.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The bed capacity of the Western Leyte General Hospital in the Municipality of Baybay, Province of Leyte, is hereby increased from fifty to seventy-five.

The sum of two hundred thousand pesos, or so much thereof as may be necessary, is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to carry out the purpose of this Act during the fiscal year nineteen hundred seventy-two. Thereafter, such sum as may be needed for its operation and maintenance in subsequent years shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
